methodology.evaluation: Read-only counterfactual: evaluate each entry against the implemented rule before exception suppression. Transpile the existing TypeScript rule modules and governance-helpers with the installed TypeScript compiler in memory; use their actual walkSync, relPath, isExcepted/minimatch, isRouteFile, isExcludedPath and regex objects. Do not execute Vitest describe blocks or application modules.
methodology.sourceUniverse: walkSync(apps) extensions .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.mjs. Skip node_modules, dist, .next, .turbo, build, coverage, .git, __fixtures__, .venv, playwright-report, test-results. Paths in JSON use the rule's normalized repository-relative slash notation.
methodology.archLayer: Only apps/*/app/api/, pages/api/, src/routes/, server/ paths; skip .test/.spec JS/TS files and __tests__. Count every matching prohibited pattern on each line, not DB operations. All server/ files are treated as routes by the actual implementation.
methodology.noConsole: Actual SCAN_ROOTS is only apps, despite the header mentioning runtime packages. Skip test/spec/__tests__, scripts, tools, tooling, seeds, config/setup files. Count the first direct console.log/info/warn/error/debug call per line. The conditional civic archived-proof CLI exemption cannot intersect any of these 22 entry globs.
limitations: These are lexical rule matches, not executed production events or a proof of tenant isolation.

ARCH_LAYER_001 includes schema imports and drizzle instantiation but misses @nzila/db/platform, @nzila/db/scoped, local @/db imports, most named repository paths, dynamic imports and multiline from clauses.

matchedSourceFileCount counts walked source files matching the glob; scannedFileCount additionally applies the actual rule's scope. An existing app directory is not proof that its exception is necessary.
